pages.title: Omega
pages.text: The first ordinal after all the natural numbers, the first step into infinity. It comes after every finite number but is not the largest of anything. The token is smooth and plain, with no predecessor.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I counted the natural numbers in the Ordinal Recursor with ordinal shards and stone. When they ran out, the next step was omega. I also found tokens of it in the Ordinal Spire.

Made in $(item)Ordinal Recursor$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Ordinal Spire chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes II, Cardinal Shard, Epsilon-Naught.
